scope: Local revalidation of the preserved actual Gradio/Groq response, not another model call.

observation.question: What fast-charging subsidy rate, per-station cap and station count does the 2025 policy state, and are slow chargers incentivized?

result.answer:
Karnataka — source cutoff: 2026-09-23.

Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.

- Fast‑charging stations for 2W, 3W, cars and buses receive a capital subsidy of 25 percent, with the subsidy capped at Rs 10,00,000 per station, and the scheme authorises up to 500 stations to be incentivised. [S2](https://investkarnataka.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Clean-mobility-policy.pdf#page=22)
- Slow‑charging stations are not eligible for any incentive under the 2025 Clean Mobility Policy. [S2](https://investkarnataka.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Clean-mobility-policy.pdf#page=22)

Sources:

- [S2: Karnataka — Karnataka Clean Mobility Policy 2025–2030, PDF page 22](https://investkarnataka.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Clean-mobility-policy.pdf#page=22)
